script.text: Soon after his duel with Bolt Tanner, Yusei had an unfortunate run in with the chief of The Facility, Mr. Armstrong.
I found smuggled magazines in Tanner's cell! You all know that's against the rules, but I know he couldn't have gotten them alone.
His accomplice has one hour to step forward! After that – everyone here’s gonna pay the price!
Don't like it? Then you ought to figure out who helped him out.
If I were you maggots, I’d start by questioning his friends.
There’s no need for everyone to suffer! Tanner’s friend just needs to fess up! If he doesn’t, I got no problem putting all of you in permanent lockdown!
Get real!
You got somethin’ you wanna say, newbie?
There are no magazines! We both know that!
No magazines, huh? So I'm just punishing Tanner because I feel like it?
I don’t know why you’re doing this, but I know that Tanner wouldn’t do anything wrong.
You’re abusing your authority, Armstrong.
I can’t just stand here and let you accuse me of being unfair in front of everyone.
To prove that I’m a reasonable man, I’ll let you duel me out here where your fellow inmates can watch. And if you win, I’ll pardon Tanner’s offense.
But if I happen to win the duel...
Then no one here but me gets put in lockdown!
You got a deal!
What were you thinking?
You can’t duel him. You don’t have a deck. If you were hoping to use mine, the Chief took my cards from me earlier.
He took mine too. My beloved treasures...
Luckily, with the help of the other inmates in The Facility, Yusei had a little surprise for Mr. Armstrong.
Let's skip ahead to later that night.
Well, here he is – The little punk with the big mouth. And I thought you might back down.
After all, you're not allowed to have a deck in The Facility. And you need a deck to duel.
Since you’re showing up empty-handed, I win by forfeit. Now get him outta my sight!
I have a deck right here.
Wha–!? What the–!? Where’d you find those cards?
You don’t get it. You think we’re a bunch of punks who’ll gladly turn on each other. That’s not how it is. They lent me their cards so that I can take you down!
All right then. Even though you’re breaking the rules, I’m willing to uphold my end of the deal.
Guards, prepare the Duel Disks!
